summary: No gate, refusal, or error message changed - verified by diff inspection: every edit touches success-path prints or forge next step composition. The load-bearing warnings survive: pr_ready's unaccepted-decisions warning is untouched, signal raise keeps its worker-facing PAUSE instruction, stage done keeps the ledgered contract-change NOTE. The new git status call in phase.py uses fixed argv with cwd, no shell; dirty-path strings feed step TEXT only, never execution.
residual_risks: Terser output means an operator sees less by default; the deliberate counterweight is that warnings and refusals kept full verbosity, so the signal-to-noise shift favors the warnings.
